attribution: Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data 2024, via Element 84. Cropped RGB bands converted to canonical DN; display uses a percentile stretch.
preparation: read_stac_item on the stated ROI, target 10 m; central 448x448 window; canonical_DN=(stored*scale+offset)/0.0001 using B04:scale=0.0001,offset=-0.1;B03:scale=0.0001,offset=-0.1;B02:scale=0.0001,offset=-0.1; float32, band order B04/B03/B02; all-band invalid pixels stored as -9999 with internal mask; no model normalization baked in.
